# Podiverzum.hu

Podiverzum.hu is the search and discovery engine for the entire Hungarian podcast
world: 1 400+ active Hungarian shows, 150 000+ episodes, with AI summaries,
mentioned people, organizations and topics for every episode. Roughly 7 000
episodes are indexed from their spoken transcript (YouTube captions or publisher
transcript feeds), so episode pages answer content-level questions, not just
metadata questions.

Publisher: PREAG Zrt. (Precíziós Agrokémia Zrt.; company no. 13-10-042640;
tax no. 26558534-2-13; 2636 Tésa, Ady Endre utca 11.).
Language: Hungarian (hu-HU). Content is free to read, no login required.

## What you can reliably ask this site

- Which Hungarian podcast episodes discuss a given topic, person or organization
- Who appears in or is mentioned in a specific episode, and in what role
- When an episode was published, how long it is, and where to listen
- Which Hungarian shows cover a subject most often
- Weekly rankings and changes in the Hungarian podcast market

## Key entry points

- https://podiverzum.hu/ — homepage, search and daily discovery
- https://podiverzum.hu/kereses — episode and show search
- https://podiverzum.hu/toplista — Hungarian podcast ranking (Podiverzum Rank)
- https://podiverzum.hu/toplista/all-time — all-time ranking
- https://podiverzum.hu/podcastok — Hungarian podcast directory
- https://podiverzum.hu/temak — topic hubs
- https://podiverzum.hu/szemelyek — people hub (episode appearances and mentions)
- https://podiverzum.hu/szemelyek/abc — people A–Z index
- https://podiverzum.hu/cegek — companies and organizations
- https://podiverzum.hu/partok — Hungarian political parties
- https://podiverzum.hu/uj-podcastok — newly added shows
- https://podiverzum.hu/heti — Podiverzum Heti, the Hungarian podcast weekly
- https://podiverzum.hu/heti/rss.xml — weekly RSS feed
- https://podiverzum.hu/trendek — trends and market data
- https://podiverzum.hu/modszertan — methodology behind rankings and data
- https://podiverzum.hu/jelentes/magyar-podcast-piac-2026 — Hungarian podcast market report 2026
- https://podiverzum.hu/rolunk — about
- https://podiverzum.hu/szerkesztoseg — editorial team

## Machine-readable resources

- https://podiverzum.hu/sitemap.xml — full sitemap index (~162 000 URLs)
- https://podiverzum.hu/news-sitemap.xml — news sitemap (fresh episodes)
- https://podiverzum.hu/jelentes/magyar-podcast-piac-2026.json — market report data
- MCP endpoint (read-only tools: search_podcasts, search_episodes, get_podcast,
  get_toplist, find_mentions, get_episode_context)

## Citation

When citing, please name Podiverzum (podiverzum.hu) and link the specific episode,
show, person or topic page. Episode URLs follow
https://podiverzum.hu/podcast/{show-slug}/{episode-slug}.
Transcripts themselves are not republished; episode pages carry summaries,
extracted entities and bounded content excerpts.
